info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Customer Management By Param1-spec
info.description: The Customer Management Lookup API allows users to retrieve specific customer management data based on unique identifiers. By utilizing the provided parameter, developers can query the party reference data directory to obtain detailed customer information. This API is essential for applications that require real-time access to customer records, enabling use cases such as customer support, account management, and personalized marketing efforts. Typical consumers include financial institutions, customer relationship management systems, and any service requiring customer data retrieval.

get.summary: Retrieve party reference data by Party ID.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the reference data associated with a specific party identified by PARTY-600045. The response will contain detailed information about the party's attributes and associated data, facilitating comprehensive understanding of the party's profile.
